hero.title: Your Worship Companion
hero.desc: Real-time prayer times, complete Al-Quran with Tajweed, Qibla compass, digital Tasbih, and Adhan notifications. Free forever, no ads, no personal data collected.

f1.title: Accurate Prayer Times
f1.desc: Precise prayer times based on your GPS location. Powered by Aladhan API with multiple calculation methods (NU, Muhammadiyah, and more).

f2.title: Adhan & Reminders
f2.desc: Complete monthly prayer schedule with automatic Adhan notifications. Export printable Imsakiyah schedule.
bullets: Automatic Adhan notification for each prayer

f3.title: Al-Quran with
f3.desc: Read the complete 30 Juz Al-Quran with color-coded Tajweed, Latin transliteration, and Indonesian translation.
bullets: Automatic Tajweed with standard color codes

f4.title: Qibla Compass
f4.desc: Precise Qibla direction with live compass based on device sensors. Interactive map showing route to Ka'bah.

f5.title: Dhikr with
f5.desc: Elegant digital Tasbih with realistic 3D bead animations. Track dhikr counts and save daily sessions.

f6.title: Customize
f6.desc: Theme, language, calculation method, Adhan sounds, everything can be customized to your preference.

privacy.heading: Your Privacy
privacy.desc: Satu Ramadhan does not collect personally identifiable data. No accounts, and completely ad-free.
privacy.card1Desc: All preferences are stored locally on your device. No server stores your data.
privacy.card2Desc: No ad SDKs. Enjoy a devout worship experience without annoying ad interruptions.
privacy.card3Desc: GPS is only used for prayer times and Qibla. Coordinates are never stored.

download.heading: Start Worship
download.desc: Free forever. No ads. No subscriptions. Just download and begin.

footer.tagline: A complete, private, and free Islamic worship companion. Made with love for Muslims.
